{{Quote|See my lieutenant. She knows everyone on the station that needs help.|[[Inaldra]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StILtGW" />}}
'''Inaldra's Lieutenant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Talk to Inaldra's lieutenant and get some work. Tansarii Station could use someone like you to help out.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StILtGW" />}}
[[File:Inaldra_office.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Inaldra's Lieutenant in her office aboard Tansarii Point Station]]
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she resided aboard [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], where she was working as the assistant to [[Station Master]] [[Inaldra/Legends|Inaldra]]. She was among the best informed people on the station and was the person to approach to get a job. Hence, Inaldra's Lieutenant closely followed the work of the Tansarii Point staff, namely the combat [[Instructor/Legends|instructors]] [[Rydel Delan]] and [[Loche Crestingsky]], the [[Security Director (Tansarii Point Station)|security director]], the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Raylen Finn]], the [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Aja Sen]] and the [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Jolka]], as well as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Training officer/Legends|flight instructors]] [[Serissu]], [[Laetin A'shera]], [[Aleas Rans'ery]] and [[Dartas Pytin]]. As such, she often hired travelers visiting the station to provide assistance to the staff members when required. In addition, she sometimes recruited people to work with visitors or help travelers in trouble.<ref name="SWG:StILtGW" /> For instance, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Inaldra's Lieutenant hired [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to work for the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Frelka]], for the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Falrey]], for a woman named [[Ysanna (individual)|Ysanna]], for the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tarand Crowe/Legends|Tarand Crowe]], for the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel Agent]] [[Garek]], for the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Deavyn Gils]] and for the hunter [[Wyle Artis]].<ref name="SWG:StILtGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Inaldra's Lieutenant appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:StILtGW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Inaldra's Lieutenant was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:StILtGW" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
